excluded.claim: “Blitz” in Blibli's courier list is Blitz Electric Mobility (census row blitz-electric-mobility)

excluded.claim: SiCepat ships for Shopee and Lazada (SiCepat homepage partner rail)
excluded.why: The evidence is a logo wall: the names exist only as img alt/filename text (partner/shopee_hor.webp) under a partner rail on sicepat.com. A logo grid is not a naming document; the graph's rules exclude it.

excluded.claim: Ninja Xpress ships for Shopee and Lazada (ninjaxpress.co marketplace rail)
excluded.why: Logo wall — the marketplace names are carried only in image filenames (300x150-shopee.webp) with empty alt text under a 'Layanan Ninja Xpress untuk marketplace' caption. No naming text, so excluded.

excluded.claim: iDexpress ships for Shopee and Lazada (idexpress.com 'dipercaya oleh berbagai merchants' rail)
excluded.why: Logo slider under a trust-wall heading; names live in img alt/src only. A trust wall is not a rate table or help page, so excluded.

excluded.claim: Blibli's group is an investor in Cermati Fintech Group / Indodana (Dwi Cermat Pte. Ltd.)
excluded.why: GDN's filing shows its Singapore holdco holds 23.40% of Dwi Cermat Pte. Ltd. ('information technology consultancy', no significant influence). Dwi Cermat is reputedly Cermati's holdco — but no filing or first-party page names that identity, so the bridge fails and the edge is withheld.

excluded.claim: JNE ships for Evermos (JNE homepage business-partner rail)
excluded.why: Logo wall — the name lives in a partner-logo rail on jne.co.id, not in naming text. JNE's Tokopedia relationship is published instead because it rests on a named, quoted testimonial from Tokopedia's VP of Logistics on the same page.

excluded.claim: SAP Express ships for Blibli, Lazada and Sociolla (sap-express.id client rail)
excluded.why: Logo wall — 'SAPX Telah Dipercaya Oleh Berbagai Perusahaan' is a trust rail with names only in image files. SAPX's Tokopedia, CIMB Niaga, Unilever and Mengantar relationships are published instead, from courier-service agreements named in its own annual reports.

excluded.claim: Gojek, Tokopedia and Traveloka hold ownership stakes in PasarPolis
excluded.why: PasarPolis's own about page says the three unicorns funded its 2018 Series A — an investment event, not a current holding. No filing states anyone's present stake, so no ownership edge is drawn.
